entities.name: Eagyn
entities.description: A white dragon who leads the Northern Order of Otaria and dies killing the barbarians' Kidring.

entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: A little girl Eagyn saves, whom Sergeant Kort vows to protect.

entities.name: Sergeant Kort
entities.description: A raypen who swears to protect Pianna and induct her into the Order.

entities.name: Kidring
entities.description: The northern barbarians' leader, killed by Eagyn.

entities.name: Majaliwa
entities.description: A wizard whose body is possessed by Gazali when he summons a wind dragon.

entities.name: Commander Qalhata
entities.description: A descendant of Gazali fighting for Zhalfir against Femeref.

entities.name: Gazali
entities.description: Qalhata's ancestor who originally summoned the wind dragon and possesses Majaliwa.

entities.name: Rokin
entities.description: A sacrificed slave who helps overthrow the dragon lords when the Primevals fall.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who summons dragons, creates the Metathran and defends Tolaria.

entities.name: Mg'razzgh
entities.description: A Shivan dragon Urza summons as a model who tricks him to free himself.

entities.name: Riand
entities.description: Urza's student sent to steal Maraavis's egg and cursed by her.

entities.name: Maraavis
entities.description: An aquatic blue dragon whose egg is stolen and who bargains with Urza.

entities.name: Toraix
entities.description: Maraavis's unhatched dragon, killed for the Metathran.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Constructs Urza makes to fight the Phyrexians, some of which guard the Cosiman merfolk.

entities.name: Jarod
entities.description: A white dragon raised by the druid Moragh who joins the migration.

entities.name: Moragh
entities.description: An elderly druid who raised Jarod.

entities.name: Vaerix
entities.description: An outcast merfolk wizard who abducts Jarod.

entities.name: Phys
entities.description: A shipwrecked Benalian mariner who fights blue dragons on Ru-nora.

entities.name: Tilan
entities.description: A descendant of the magistrate Zulakan who fights with Phys.

entities.name: Agrippa the Wayfinder
entities.description: A marooned sailor who learns to manipulate sea dragons with fire.

entities.name: Strnak
entities.description: A shapeshifting green dragon who flees Yavimaya to Llanowar.

entities.name: Frankle
entities.description: An elf who takes Strnak in.

entities.name: Timorae
entities.description: An elf who takes Strnak in.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: The nature spirit of Llanowar who sends Strnak home.

entities.name: Deadalus
entities.description: A Nakayan lich killed by Destruction.

entities.name: Destruction
entities.description: An undead black dragon who drinks Chloridon's blood and kills Deadalus.

entities.name: Chloridon
entities.description: The most powerful green dragon in the Vintaran forest.

entities.name: Snap
entities.description: A tiny twig dragon who destroys the serpent generator and saves Cometia.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: A Keldon warlord who burns Skouras's brain out and is hailed as the new doyen of Keld.

entities.name: Skouras
entities.description: A blue dragon who replaces Kavalex and attacks minds.

entities.name: Kavalex
entities.description: A dragon with whom the Keldons made a pact, killed and replaced by Skouras.

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: The fall of the Primevals that breaks the dragon lords' magic.

events.summary: Eagyn leads the Northern Order against northern barbarians, saves Pianna and kills the Kidring but perishes.
events.quote: Then he attacks the barbarians' leader, the Kidring, and manages to kill him but perishes.

events.summary: Majaliwa summons a wind dragon that decimates the Femeref army, revealed to have been summoned by Gazali, who possesses his body.
events.quote: Majaliwa summons a powerful wind dragon, which decimates the Femeref army.

events.summary: Rokin, sacrificed to the dragon lords, helps overthrow his masters when the Primevals fall.
events.quote: allowing him and his fellow slaves to overthrow their masters

events.summary: Urza summons a Shivan dragon as a model, but it tricks him into freeing itself.
events.quote: tricks Urza into granting him enough strength to free himself from his summoning binding

events.summary: Urza's student Riand steals Maraavis's egg for the Metathran; Maraavis confronts Urza, strikes a bargain and traps Riand in an illusion.
events.quote: Maraavis then enchants Riand to experience an illusion of falling to his death on jagged reefs on-loop for 1000 days.

events.summary: After the invasion, 49 Metathran guard the Cosiman merfolk as Urza promised.
events.quote: 49 Metathran show up to become guardians of Cosiman

events.summary: Jarod is abducted by Vaerix, breaks free, saves a dragon egg and is invited to join the white dragon migration.
events.quote: Thus earning respect from his peers, he is invited to join their migration.

events.summary: Phys and Tilan fight blue dragons in a kite cage; the kite is bitten loose and carries them to Benalish shores.
events.quote: sending the kite soaring high over the clouds

events.summary: Agrippa learns to manipulate the island's sea dragons with fire and escapes with gold to clear his great-grandfather's name.
events.quote: He builds a boat in secret and then escapes with some of the gold from the beach

events.summary: Strnak helps the elves fight a red dragon, then Molimo reveals evil sorcery created it and sends Strnak home.
events.quote: Molimo sends a portal spell to bring Strnak back to his family in Yavimaya

events.summary: Deadalus raises four dragons as undead; Destruction drinks Chloridon's blood and kills Deadalus.
events.quote: Destruction finally returns to Deadalus and kills him.

events.summary: Snap destroys the serpent generator, saving the oasis of Cometia.
Astor burns out Skouras's brain with the Lethans' fury and is hailed as the new doyen of Keld.
